title: Xbox Project Helix is a console first, says Xbox 🎮
subject: projecthelix
description:
Would you buy a console that plays your PC games? 👇

In Xbox's 25th anniversary magazine, Jason Ronald, Xbox vice president of next generation, said Project Helix is a console that can also play games from your PC, not a PC that plays console games. He also pointed to neural rendering as a way to push performance as component costs rise. No price or release date has been announced.

Sources: Xbox Wire 25th anniversary magazine (Nov 15, 2026), Video Games Chronicle (Nov 16, 2026), TrueAchievements

scenes.text: Xbox's next console will play your PC games.

scenes.text: In Xbox's 25th anniversary magazine, vice president Jason Ronald called Project Helix a console first.
His words: a console that is also capable of playing games from your PC.
No driver updates, no settings to tweak, and four generations of your Xbox library come along.
With component costs rising, Xbox is betting on neural rendering for extra performance.
Helix still has no price or release date.
